checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The basic services line has includesText but has no price, priceRange or priceText, so the priced condition is not met.
No second mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead such as a facilities fee or handling fee appears in the text.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming line is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation lines are on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states a casket is required for direct cremation; the list offers purchaser-provided and alternative containers.
The direct cremation description lists transportation and authorizations with optional cremation wording, and no separate crematory cash advance is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own lines, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or description.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
No text claims a product delays decomposition long-term or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and disclosures appear in standard wording without hard-to-notice formatting shown.
